name: EXAMPLE Customer Brand
_comment: COPY THIS FILE when a client asks us to produce their design docs in THEIR branding.
Name it <client-slug>.json in this folder, then pass --brand-profile <client-slug>.
The quality gates do NOT change when the brand changes. Structure, row heights, wrap,
clipping, title placement, single type scale and single border neutral are all checked the
same way - only the colours, fonts and logo asset come from here. That is the whole point of
keeping brand in a profile: a client-branded document must come out as cleanly formatted as
WHAT TO ASK THE CLIENT FOR:
1. Their brand guide (palette hex values and the approved type pairing).
2. A PNG or SVG of the wordmark cleared for document use, ideally >= 300px wide, on a
TRANSPARENT background, in the variant approved for light backgrounds.
3. The wordmark's locked aspect ratio, or a file we can measure it from.
4. Whether their fonts are licensed for our machines. If not, pick the closest pair that
ships with Office and say so in the doc's Version Control entry - a document that
renders with substituted fonts on the client's machine is worse than one that uses
CONTRAST: band_text must be legible on band, and header_text on header_fill. Check it - a
dark-on-dark header is the most common failure when swapping in a client palette.
